transcript.t: Hi, I'm Sara. Every student in our class has a locker. My locker is at the back of the classroom. It is next to Amy's locker. I keep my sports clothes and my school bag in it. In my drawer, I keep my pens and my notebook. My locker is always tidy.

sections.title: 一、听材料，选择正确答案

options: At the back of the classroom.

questions.stem: Whose locker is next to hers?
questions.why: It is next to Amy's locker.

questions.stem: What does Sara keep in the drawer?
questions.why: In my drawer, I keep my pens and my notebook.
